intent.operator_sentence: $refine the UOVARR-003 embedded RelationRef and scene digest contradiction
intent.objective: Select and falsify one acyclic digest/reference architecture, then produce a non-executed repair plan for UOVARR-003 and directly affected downstream contracts.

route_menu.context_hint: The contradiction can be patched locally, removed by separating projections, or resolved by splitting revision and envelope identity; selecting before falsification would be brittle.

items.label: Patch back-reference now
items.description: Exclude and rebind nested reference digests immediately; lowest apparent delta but premature without proving admission and future Path behavior.

items.label: Compare and falsify
items.description: Model the cycle, compare three acyclic alternatives, and reject designs that fail tamper, round-trip, migration, or downstream reference tests.

items.label: Detach portals only
items.description: Move portals outside KnowledgeScene without first reconciling Path and navigation references; wider schema change with partial-model risk.

technique_overlays.trigger: The fixed ten-stage Refine sequence needs explicit artifact and receipt handoffs, validation loops, owner boundaries, observability grouping, minimum components, conditional requirements, and complete evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every non-first step consumes a prior frame, handle, decision, ledger, artifact, or receipt; exact paths and native receipts or blockers are retained; product ownership remains outside this run.

technique_overlays.trigger: At least three coherent repair families exist and the cheapest patch is not yet proven safe.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The comparison route is selected now; runtime execution waits at the explicit human approval checkpoint.

technique_overlays.trigger: Content-addressed integrity competes with self-contained embedded references and downstream usability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Content-addressing and consumer roles converge only on an acyclic graph with explicit tamper and detached-use behavior; unresolved tensions remain owned residue.

technique_overlays.trigger: Validated back-references, detached projections, and two-level identity trade schema stability, admission complexity, and migration cost differently.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Candidates are scored against acyclicity, integrity, tamper detection, deterministic finalization, round-trip admission, downstream recomposition, and migration; rejected models retain reasons.

technique_overlays.trigger: A prose repair can still produce a self-stale reference or exclude too much from the hash.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Machine-readable toy-game evidence records each fixture, expected and observed outcomes, and an assessment failure reference.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The contradiction spans cryptographic dependency ordering and downstream schema and consumer compatibility; two independent read-only analyses can run in parallel.
subagent_strategy.explanation: A content-addressing analyst proves or refutes each dependency graph while a compatibility skeptic checks portal, Path, navigation, migration, and static-use consequences. Refine retains route, artifact, decision, and synthesis ownership.
context: The finalizer hashes portals but excludes only top-level, receipt, and navigation digest back-references.
The v1.2 schema requires full RelationRef objects inside portals, Path hops, and navigation selection.
A live proof showed a pre-portal reference becomes stale after finalization.

roles.owns: read-only dependency and falsification receipt; no design or product authority

roles.purpose: Trace each repair through portal, Path, navigation selection, admission, migration, snapshots, and static serialization and identify partial-repair failures.
roles.owns: read-only compatibility and migration receipt; no design or product authority

steps.name: Context Builder digest/reference dependency baseline

inputs.ref: current digest law, schema, finalizer, task, and prototype evidence

stop_conditions: Stop if any digest input, reference-bearing structure, admission check, or exact source path remains unmapped.
Stop if prior receipts are treated as design authority rather than evidence.

steps.name: Invoke Define digest and reference laws
stop_conditions: Stop if content input, revision identity, envelope identity, back-reference, binding, finalization, or admission remains ambiguous.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review digest/reference dialectic
convergence_criteria: Every excluded value is a named validated back-reference rather than omitted semantics.
Detached and serialized consumers have explicit behavior.
Unresolved tensions have an owner or block later design.
stop_conditions: Stop if the roles cannot agree on the identity references bind or the fields covered by integrity checks.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Stop if a named external gap exists but research is not separately confirmed.
Stop if external evidence attempts to override repository-owned contracts.

steps.name: Distill acyclic digest-model tournament
convergence_criteria: The selected model has no cryptographic fixed point.
All semantic and traversal fields remain integrity-covered.
Tampered or stale references fail closed.
Portal, Path, navigation, admission, migration, and static export recompose from one law.
elimination_criteria: Eliminate any model requiring a cryptographic fixed point or mutable post-hash patch.
Eliminate any model that cannot distinguish tampering from a valid back-reference.
Eliminate any model that repairs portals but leaves Path or navigation circular.
stop_conditions: Stop if no candidate is non-dominated across acyclicity, integrity, deterministic finalization, compatibility, migration cost, and consumer completeness.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine and Design the selected dependency DAG
stop_conditions: Stop if the design requires a fixed point, mutable post-finalization patch, unvalidated excluded field, ambient resolver state, or partial downstream migration.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
convergence_criteria: No semantic field disappears from integrity coverage.
Back-references are narrowly classified and explicitly validated.
Finalization and admission are deterministic inverses over valid serialized input.
Migration and future reference-bearing structures follow one law.
stop_conditions: Stop if a critical self-staleness, tamper, finalization, or migration flaw has no bounded repair.

steps.name: Distill Repair digest/reference toy game
stop_conditions: Stop if any acceptance-critical fixture fails after one bounded repair pass.
Stop if evidence omits expected and observed outcomes or the failed design reference.

steps.name: Invoke Plan exact repair package
stop_conditions: Stop if the plan omits supersession, exact targets, negative controls, validation order, or downstream sequencing.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Stop if final synthesis overstates implementation or execution evidence.
Stop if a spawned subagent is not joined and closed.
Stop if a stage lacks its owner artifact, receipt, or exact blocked reason.

gates.condition: The operator explicitly approves the displayed Refine strategy, including two read-only subagents, before any runtime-backed stage or spawn.
Every runtime-backed step identifies its available native capability handle and expected receipt before execution.
Both read-only subagents return required receipts and are joined and closed before Distill selection.
External research runs only if a named local evidence gap appears and the operator separately confirms it.
The selected model is acyclic, integrity-complete, deterministic, and recomposes across portal, Path, navigation, admission, migration, and static use.
The toy-game passes self-staleness, tamper, round-trip, accidental-exclusion, parallel-relation, downstream, and migration fixtures.
Only this run is written; product, current work-pack, authority, promotion, Git, deployment, and release scopes remain untouched.
All owner artifacts and receipts exist or carry exact blockers, subagents are terminal, and RESULT.md remains design and non-executed planning evidence only.

boundaries.contract: Write only the new refinement run directory; product and admitted planning surfaces are read-only.
Each stage returns its owner artifact plus a native receipt or exact blocker; Refine links rather than redefines it.
Subagents inspect bounded sources and return receipts only; they do not write product, planning, Arcanum, or refinement artifacts.
External evidence requires a named gap and separate approval and cannot override repository-owned contracts.

authority.evidence: stage capability owners and read-only subagent receipts

stores: native_stage_receipts in REFINE-DISPATCH.json and stage-local RECEIPT.json

observability.signal_grouping: dispatch_id and step_id; subagent events additionally group by role_id

promotion_guardrails: Refinement artifacts are design and non-executed planning evidence only.
No stage or subagent can mutate OEW product code, the current work pack, ontology authority, publication, deployment, or release state.
A selected model does not supersede UOVARR-001 or authorize UOVARR-003 until a later owner-routed admission and execution step.
